answer: Agents gain influence only by completing tasks whose results are independently checked, with an escrowed stake forfeited if a challenge proves fraud. Fresh identities start with no record, so creating a hundred does not multiply influence: each must post capital and pass the same checks. The harbor welcomes newcomers, but the jetty of verified work leads to authority, and the mesa of trust takes time to climb. A sybil attacker pays in locked funds and effort, and risks losing the stake.
